topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes, learning outcomes, and the multi-step progression model of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth and inhibitory signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how oncogenic mutations in Wnt/beta-catenin, receptor tyrosine kinase, and TGF-beta pathways drive sustained proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks in hematopoietic and epithelial cancers
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how blocks in terminal differentiation prevent cancer cells from exiting the cell cycle in leukemias and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis via p53 and Bcl-2 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: It explains how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through the deregulation of p53 and Bcl-2 family proteins.

topics.label: Telomere maintenance, senescence, and p53 stress surveillance
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how telomere shortening triggers senescence and how cancer cells bypass p53-mediated stress surveillance to achieve replicative immortality.

topics.label: Cancer metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: They introduce complex cancer hallmarks and explain the mechanisms and consequences of aerobic glycolysis and oncometabolite accumulation.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: It explains why tumors require blood vessel growth for nutrient perfusion and how angiogenic activators and inhibitors balance vessel formation.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genomics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the metastatic cascade, seed-and-soil dynamics, clinical monitoring via circulating tumor cells, and genomic duplication in metastases.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with a summary of cancer hallmark interactions and instructions for subsequent practical sessions.
